info.title: MeteringCo API
info.description: Welcome to the API! MeteringCo makes it easy to bill customers based on usage. We take care of the measurement of usage, creating offerings, processing payment and analyzing cost.

tags.name: Authentication
Offerings
tags.description: An offering represents, a SKU to your business. As an example a SaaS business may have a public offering where users pay per megabyte, and they could have a different offering with a big client where they pay per Gb

tags.name: Services
tags.description: A service is a specific implementation of a SaaS offering, for example you may have multiple services per customer, a dev service and a prod service would be two examples. Each service can have the same offering or different offerings.

tags.name: Customers
tags.description: Customers are the clients who are interacting with your SaaS. Importantly for MeteringCo we need to know your customers Identifier and the payment channel which to charge them through

tags.name: Dimensions
tags.description: Create and Manage Dimensions to be used with offerings, includes the aggregation information as well as units and dimension Price. For example if an offering has Uptime and Provisioned Capacity, there should one dimension for each

tags.name: Invoices
tags.description: Invoices are generated by MeteringCo and sent to your customers. You can also use the API to get a list of invoices for a customer, or a specific invoice

tags.name: Analytics
tags.description: MeteringCo provides a number of analytics endpoints to help you understand your business. These include: Cost, Usage, Revenue, Profit, and Margins

Unique identifier assigned by MeteringCo.

Example `"de388932-a7e1-11ed-afa1-0242ac120002"`

measurementName.description: A friendly, human-readable name of the measurement.

aggregationInterval.description:
Time interval to aggregate dimension usage data for billing.

Default: `"hour"`

aggregationMethod.description:
The algorithm to aggregate raw usage data for billing.

Default: `"max"`

measurement.description: The measurement attached to the dimension

dimensionName.description:
A friendly, human-readable name for the dimension.

Example `"API Call"`

consumptionUnit.description:
Consumption unit of the dimension. MeteringCo supports three types of consumption units: count-based, time-based, and data-based. Supported values for each consumption unit type are listed below.
- count-based: `"count"`
- time-based: `"second"`, `"minute"`, `"hour"`, `"day"`
- data-based: `"byte"`, `"kilobyte"`, `"megabyte"`, `"gigabyte"`
This field accepts a JSON object with the following schema:
``` { "type": "typeName", "unit": "unitName" } ```

Example:
`{ "type": "count", "unit": "count-based" }`
`{ "type": "time", "unit": "hour" }`
`{ "type": "data", "unit": "byte" }`

usageIncrement.description:
The minimum increment for usage amount. As an example, if usage increment is 1 Hour job execution time, then 1 Hour and 5 Minutes execution time may be calculated as 1 Hour or 2 Hours, depending on the rounding algorithm field of the dimension.

Example `1`

rounding.description: The rounding algorithm that is used to calculate the amount of usage increment. Ceiling algorithm rounds up and floor algorithm rounds down. As an example, if usage increment is 1 Hour job execution time, then 1 Hour and 5 Minutes execution time may be calculated as 1 Hour or 2 Hours, depending on the rounding algorithm field of the dimension.

usageEntitlement.description:
Used with Subscription Tier Offering type.
SaaS customers subscribed to a subscription tier are entitled to use the amount of product with regard to the dimension up to the value specified in this field. For example, a subscription tier may entitle subscribers to make up to 1,000,000 API requests.

overageAllowed.description:
Used with Subscription Tier Offering type.
When the usage entitlement is specified, this field decides if allowing SaaS customers to use more than entitled amount of the product dimension.

consumptionPrice.description: The unit price of dimension. Numerical values are represented as strings to avoid precision loss.

offeringVisibility.description:
The visibility of the offering, specifically if its private or public. Public offerings are designed to be shared among customers. Private offerings are typically used for enterprise deals which contain discounts or prepaid credits.

Default: `public`

offeringType.description:
The type of offering plan.
• `usage-based` - The offering is a pure usage-based offering, or pay-as-you-go. Customer will be billed based on the precise usage of the service.
• `tier` - The offering is a tiered offering, or a subscription. Customer will be billed based on the tier price they are subscribed to.

Default: `usage-based`

currency.description: Currently only USD is supported as a currency.

dimensions.description: The list of dimensions attached to the offering.

discount.description:
Discount to be applied to the bill of services subscribed to this offering. Only numerical string is allowed.

Example: `"0.2"` for 20% off.

prepaidCredit.description:
Prepaid credit amount to be deducted as part of the bill payments. Only numerical string is allowed.

Example: `"20.00"` for $20.00.

billingCycle.description:
The time frame when an automatic bill should be sent leave empty for no automated billing

Default: `monthly`
